import jobs

def test_stable_first_occurrence_wins():
    rows = [
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 2},
    ]
    res = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert [r['title'] for r in res] == ['a', 'a']

def test_no_merge_across_sources():
    rows = [
        {'title': 'x', 'source': 's1', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'x', 'source': 's2', 'source_id': 1},
    ]
    res = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(res) == 2
    assert {(r['source'], r['source_id']) for r in res} == {('s1', 1), ('s2', 1)}

def test_no_merge_by_title():
    rows = [
        {'title': 'dup', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'other', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
    ]
    res = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(res) == 2

def test_missing_source_id_kept_separately():
    rows = [
        {'title': 'x', 'source': 's', 'source_id': None},
        {'title': 'x', 'source': 's', 'source_id': ''},
        {'title': 'x', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'x', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
    ]
    res = jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert len(res) == 3

def test_does_not_mutate_input():
    rows = [
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
        {'title': 'a', 'source': 's', 'source_id': 1},
    ]
    copy = list(rows)
    jobs.unique_jobs(rows)
    assert rows == copy
